European HQ Brussels | CNC Machine Expertise | Technical Sales Support | European Scope | International Environment | Permanent Contract

 

 Job at a glance

• Location: Zaventem, Brussels region, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience
• Benefits: Electric company car, fuel or charging card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
• Work arrangement: Mainly office-based, combined with European travel
 About The Organisation
This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
 The organisation works with a network of dedicated distributors across different European countries. These local partners are responsible for selling and supporting the machines within their respective markets.

 

What will you do?Technical sales and pre-sales support

• Provide technical support to European distributors, Sales Managers and Sales Engineers.
• Advise on CNC machines, options, applications and configurations.
• Translate customer requirements into suitable technical solutions.
• Support sales teams throughout the commercial process, including product positioning, promotions and special pricing requests.
• Resolve technical or commercial issues that could delay a sale.
Relationship building and commercial insight

• Build strong relationships with distributors and local sales teams.
• Maintain regular contact to understand market needs, challenges and opportunities.
• Identify sales blockers, risks and potential business opportunities.
• Gather field feedback and translate it into actionable commercial insights.
• Share relevant market intelligence with the Sales Manager and internal teams.
Cross-functional coordination

• Collaborate with Sales, Applications, Service, Logistics, Marketing, IT and Product Management.
• Coordinate and follow up on cross-functional issues until resolution.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support new product launches across Europe.
Training, demonstrations and customer visits

• Deliver product and application training to distributors and sales teams.
• Demonstrate CNC machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support and coordinate customer and distributor visits to the European headquarters and showroom.
• Ensure machines, tooling and materials are ready for demonstrations.
• Support the coordination and smooth operation of the showroom.
Reporting and independent working

• Work autonomously and organise activities independently.
• Provide structured weekly reporting to the Sales Manager.
• Report and escalate sales blockers, missed opportunities and critical issues.
• Keep internal stakeholders informed about relevant customer and market developments.
 

What do you need?
Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering or another technical field.
• Equivalent technical expertise gained through professional experience can also be considered.
• At least approximately five years of relevant experience in a CNC, machining, manufacturing, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Practical knowledge of CNC machines or experience working in a production environment.
• Experience with machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers or press brakes is a strong advantage.
• The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience supporting sales teams, customers, distributors or other commercial stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects or working with different internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.
• The ability to work independently and confidently in an international environment.
• A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP is an advantage.Your strengthsYou are technically strong, communicative and commercially aware. You enjoy solving technical problems, but you also understand the urgency and business impact behind a sales opportunity.You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating different stakeholders and following issues through until they are resolved. As you will regularly work independently and travel throughout Europe, you can structure your own activities and make well-considered decisions.
 You are also:

• Mature and confident in your communication
• Hands-on and solution-oriented
• Proactive and responsive
• Customer-focused
• Commercially minded
• Structured and detail-oriented
• Comfortable working autonomously
• Capable of building trusted professional relationships
• Eager to deepen your knowledge of CNC machine technologies
• Able to remain calm and effective when priorities change or rapid action is required

• Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
• Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
• A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
• Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of an Azure-based data platform, ensuring data is accessible, high-quality, and fit for purpose.This is a hands-on, execution-focused data engineering role, where you will work primarily on SQL transformations, data pipelines, and platform optimisation. You will contribute to building robust and scalable data solutions that enable analytics and reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities

• You build, monitor and optimize data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Data Factory
• You design and optimize data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics)
• You develop and maintain scalable SQL transformations
• You ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platfform
• You collaborate with analysts and business teams to deliver reliable and usable datasets
• You support data governance, security, and compliance requirements

Your Profile 

• You bring solid experience in data engineering (min. 5 years), preferably within an Azure-based environment
• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.
• You have strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms and transformation processes
• You communicate fluently in English, knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Responsibilities

• Develop comprehensive test plans and scenarios covering functional, integration, and performance requirements.
• Design and implement automated test suites to streamline non-regression testing and improve efficiency.
• Execute test scenarios and document results with detailed evidence such as logs and screenshots.
• Report and monitor defects using bug-tracking tools while collaborating with developers on resolutions.
• Validate application readiness for deployment between test and acceptance environments.
• Select and prepare necessary test data to ensure high-quality test execution.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in test automation using Python or similar scripting languages.
• You possess 5+ years of expertise in performance testing and non-functional testing methodologies.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in test design, including the creation of test plans and functional scenarios.
• You have a solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases and associated queries.
• You possess experience working within Agile and Scrum teams.
• You're able to understand technical concepts including APIs, Web Services, and front-end/back-end architectures.
• You're proactive, possess a critical mind, and are comfortable challenging existing implementations.
• You are fluent in English with knowledge of French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Playwright or Robot Framework.
• Knowledge of RabbitMQ or similar messaging systems.
• Experience with DevOps workflows and security testing.

Every registration, renewal and transfer runs through one platform. You decide how it evolves.

Product Owner | Registration & Domain Lifecycle

Our client is a European, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, that operates one of the largest domain registries in the world in the public interest.

Its product is a lifecycle: a name is registered, renewed, transferred, suspended or released, millions of times over, through a network of accredited partners and under rules it does not set alone.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to the service partners depend on daily.

To drive this, the organisation is looking for a Product Owner to set the vision, own the roadmap and make the trade-offs that come with a service nobody can afford to see go down.

 

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and priorities of the registration platform and of the lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate partner needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience, security and long-term sustainability.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to keep requirements understood, feasible and aligned.
• Track adoption, usability and service quality, and turn what the numbers show into roadmap and backlog decisions.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• At least seven years in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Familiarity with the domain-name ecosystem, EPP, WHOIS or RDAP and DNS provisioning is a clear advantage — but it is learnable quickly if you come from another transaction-intensive, partner-driven platform: telecom provisioning, payments, utilities or any regulated service with complex lifecycles.
• Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of other European languages is an asset.

• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.

Requirements

• You possess 3+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst.

Nice to Haves

• Background in the energy, utilities, finance, or other regulated industries.

• Trilingual proficiency in English, French, and Dutch.

Context

Europe in the spotlight. You at the heart of the action.

Ready for your next professional challenge? Euronews is looking for a Camera Operator to join its Brussels headquarters.

Work alongside talented professionals from around the world and be part of an exciting, dynamic environment, contributing to the news and show production.

This versatile role offers the opportunity to be involved in every stage of production, from filming and editing to broadcast, both in Brussels and in the field. Your work will span a wide range of formats, including live shots, two-ways, news reports, interviews and programmes.

Main responsibilities

The cameraman works alongside the journalists and correspondents of the Brussels office. The main responsibilities include:

Filming and camera operation (field and studio)

• Filming reports, interviews, campaign rallies, candidate visits and vox pops, in Paris and across France.
• Shooting in fast-paced news conditions: sound recording, light-kit lighting, framing in challenging environments (crowds, rally venues, campaign HQs).
• Setting up and operating live shots and two-ways from the field (LiveU/TVU-type bonded cellular units, IP links, returns).
• In-bureau productions: studio and remote interviews, presenter links, guest panels.
Editing and post-production

• Editing reports, short news pieces and digital/social formats, often on very tight deadlines.
• Integrating graphics, basic sound mixing and simple colour grading.
• Transcoding, exporting and transferring media to distribution platforms.
Technical operations and production

• Technical preparation: setting up the studio or live position, checking and adjusting equipment, establishing contribution links, recording.
• Operating equipment: cameras, lighting, players and recorders, vision mixer, audio console and audio equipment, production automation, cloud-based production system.
• Using production techniques: chroma key, virtual studio, physical sets.
• Receiving, processing and distributing external feeds and files (pools, agencies, debate and election night feeds).
• Managing storage and archiving rushes.
• Providing technical support to journalists during live TV 
Required Skills and Qualifications 

Technical skills

• Experience: at least 5 years in a similar role (camera operator/video journalist) at a TV channel or news agency.
• Strong news camera skills (shoulder-mount and handheld cameras) and field sound recording.
• Proficiency in an editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Avid Media Composer or equivalent) and news editing workflows.
• Experience with live TV and mobile transmission (LiveU, TVU or equivalent).
• Good understanding of multi-camera production and studio and field lighting.
• Knowledge of graphics systems.
• Understanding of the newsroom environment: organisation and tools (NRCS).
• Languages: fluent English (C1-C2), other languages are a plus
• Driving licence preferred.
 Versatility, team spirit and a service-oriented mindset.

• Adaptability and responsiveness to a fast-changing news agenda.
• Organisation, precision and method.
• Strong interpersonal skills, discretion and field awareness.
• Availability, stamina and composure, especially during peak periods.
Additional information

• Location: Brussels, EU Quarter area
• Contract type: Fixed-Term
• Working hours: full time
• Flexibility required: early / late and weekends shifts are possible
• Start date: as soon as possible
